findings.title: the governed-run check is defined inside a block that dispatched lanes skip
findings.disposition_rationale: Moved the check out of the skip-gated Mint list to its own line under Step 3, stated for every lane (commit 0fa7e5e4).

findings.title: SKILL_LINE_BASELINE values diverge from the spec stated expectation
findings.disposition_rationale: validate-adapters counts lines as wc+1; the spec numbers were wc counts. Baselines follow the spec rule (set to the resulting counts as the tool measures them): faff-graft 956 (+1), faff-beep-boop 777 (unchanged). Recorded in the PR body.

findings.title: the status-failure stop rule is prose-only with no behavioural test of the failure path
findings.disposition_rationale: test/commissaire-status-skill-sites.test.mjs now rejects fallback wording (proceed, fall back, ungoverned, treat as governed) in any sentence naming commissaire-status-failed outside the canonical sentence; mutation-checked. The stop itself is skill prose executed by an agent, so a behavioural test of the agent is out of reach.
